overview.text: The Yellow-lipped Sea Krait is a highly venomous sea snake of the tropical Indian and Pacific Oceans. It hunts underwater but comes back onto land to rest, digest and lay eggs.

identification.text: Black bands, a black head with a yellow upper lip and snout, and a paddle-shaped tail for swimming.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Coasts of the eastern Indian Ocean and western Pacific, from eastern India and Sri Lanka through South-east Asia to New Guinea, Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia, and north to Taiwan and the Ryukyu Islands.

behaviour.text: Spends about half its time in the sea and half on land; young ones stay near the water.

recognise.text: Black-and-blue bands, yellow lip, paddle tail.
